Gl in life and kindest regards. Remember that you can always find a way through tough times, there is always an option, even if if seems everything is lost, even if life seems like a dead end, there are ways through. Keep your head and spirits high, don't let other people get to you and don't let us, or yourself down. You're positive gestures and attitude, guise or not, will be missed.
